author: __flcl

author: bosulmun
content:
If we use different orderings, we will disconnect each other and only geth peers will be connected to each other. (because for geth, providing cells that cannot pass kzg verification is a reason to disconnect) As far as I know we fixed this issue by changing geth side to use index major

But I also think blob major is more intuitive, because we were anyway storing blobs in blob-wise before 8070. So if other clients are okay with this I think it is good to change it back to blob major.

Let me know today/tomorrow if anyone has a different point of view, otherwise I will review and merge fab10's PR
